dustBound.definition: after a successful pool(a, ...): leftover_side <= 4 * (2 + a/preRS) * (1 + ceil(price of the other side in this side's wei)), evaluated at post-pool reserves
dustBound.derivation: The closed-form s = (sqrt(r(1997^2 r + 3988000 a)) - 1997 r)/1994 is the exact real root of 997 s^2 + 1997 r s - 1000 a r = 0 (verified). Integer flooring of s (<1 wei), getAmountOut (<1 wei phUSD) and Router quote() (<1 wei) leave <= a few wei of one side unmatched, priced into the other side (x ceil(price)); the 1-wei floor in rP2 = rP - out is amplified by amtS/rS2 <= a/preRS inside quote(). Empirically confirmed: input 250x reserve leaves 56,398 wei sUSDS = 14.5 x ceil(price 3893); a 1:1.06 pool leaves <= 15 wei.
dustBound.interpretation: wei-level: at realistic pool sizes the bound is tens of wei; it is NOT a value-relative tolerance and is orders of magnitude below any UI slippage tolerance.
